# MakePace

> An open-source desktop workspace for researching content formats, producing batches, refining previews and scheduling approved posts.

MakePace runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and connects to the user's Codex account.
Optional Apify and OneUp connections support social research and publishing.
Software is Apache-2.0 licensed; connected services may charge separately.
Current installers are alpha software, unsigned, and not notarized on macOS.
Local operation does not mean offline AI: selected content goes to connected services.

## Official sources
- [Product overview](https://www.makepace.app/about/): Workflow, requirements and limitations.
- [Source and installation](https://github.com/alonsosolisg/makepace): README, license and contribution instructions.
- [Releases](https://github.com/alonsosolisg/makepace/releases): Published versions and checksums.
- [Privacy](https://www.makepace.app/privacy/): Website and desktop data handling.
- [Terms](https://www.makepace.app/terms/): Website use and software license.
